title: CatalogRuntimesCategory
description: The category hierarchy of your store as it appears on the storefront. This is the category heirarchy defined with the admin/category resource except for any categories with an IsDisplayed value set to false.

categoryCode.description: External unique identifier of the category.

categoryId.description: Internal unique identifier of the category. System-supplied and read-only.

childrenCategories.description: List of subcategories that belong to this category.

count.description: Indicates whether the category should be displayed.

isDisplayed.description: Indicates whether the category should be displayed.

sequence.description: Order in which categories appear when they are at the same level (siblings). For example, categories can be sequenced so that a specific category always appears first (or last).

shouldSlice.description: Indicates whether the category should be sliced

CategoryContent.description: Name of the category and optionally, a description, page title, friendly URL, associated images, and any metadata.

description.description: Description of the category as it appears on the storefront.

metaTagDescription.description: Metadata description. Metadata can be used to manage information internally.

metaTagKeywords.description: Metadata keywords. Metadata can be used to manage information internally.

metaTagTitle.description: Metadata title. Metadata can be used to manage information internally.

name.description: Name of the category as it appears on the storefront.

pageTitle.description: Title that appears at the top of new pages.

slug.description: Human-readable identifier given to the category to create friendly URLs.

CategoryImage.description: Image or video associated with a category.

altText.description: Descriptive text associated with the image. Unicode data with a maximum length of 200 characters.

cmsId.description: Id of the image in the CMS.

imageLabel.description: Image title.  Unicode data with a maximum length of 50 characters.

imageUrl.description: Image URL. Unicode data with a maximum length of 4000 characters.

mediaType.description: Type of media. Used by the client to determine how to render the image or video or what have you.

sequence.description: For categories with multiple images, the sequence is the order in which this image appears. Whole number data. Required.

videoUrl.description: URL of the video. Unicode data with a maximum length of 4000 characters.
